1.en_consolidated_definition:
To disassemble or dismantle something, often in a careless or haphazard manner, typically referring to the process of taking apart an old or worn-out object, such as furniture, into its constituent parts for disposal or reuse.

Nota: La palabra "desvencijar" es un término coloquial en español puertorriqueño que se refiere a la acción de desmontar o desarmar algo de manera descuidada o improvisada.
